newsitem.title: UK: UK shares take fright at jump in inflation.
newsitem.headline: UK shares take fright at jump in inflation.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index fell over one percent on Tuesday, dragged down by the prospect of an interest rate rise later this week and inflation figures which did little to calm fears that more rate rises may be needed to cool buoyant consumer demand.
The leading index finished 52.2 points lower at 4,758.5, just above the day's low of 4,751.9. Decliners outpaced advancers roughly three times. The Mid-250 lost 26.1 to 4,400.
"The market needed to consolidate after a meteoric ride," said the head of market-making at a leading brokerage. "There was no heavy selling, we did not come under massive pressure."
